standard_prerequisites.use: Injectivity of x -> {x}: singletons of distinct sets are distinct.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 459-461): cardless(A, Pow A) for any set A.
Injection half (proof lines 463-468): f(x) = {x} is injective since x != y implies {x} != {y} by extensionality.

Non-surjectability half (lines 470-508, oliflabeldef else-branch rendering): by reductio suppose g : A -> Pow A is a bijection; D = {x in A : x notin g(x)} is a subset of A hence in Pow A; bijection gives y with g(y) = D; then y in g(y) iff y in D iff y notin g(y), a contradiction. (The alternate slow branch carries the same diagonal argument against mere surjectivity, also complete in-source.)
proof_roadmap: Diagonal set D from a would-be bijection.
y in g(y) iff y in D iff y notin g(y) closes the reductio.
difficulty_reason: Cantor's theorem (statement 459-461, proof 463-508): both halves carried - the singleton injection and the full diagonal reductio; the oliflabeldef conditional selects the fast complete branch, the slow branch is likewise complete in-source. H2.
